name: Notebook scribble
oneLiner: close on a real yellow legal pad on a leather blotter: a real ballpoint writes a short list on the rules, its tip riding the ink on twos, then loops one word in a brand-colour circle and lifts away
say: when the speaker lays out a plan or a short list and leans on one word ('three steps, and you film it once'): the lines write on as they list them and the circle lands on the word they stress
